lines.zh: 我钻在沙里，只露一对颚。
lines.en: I move under the sand, only my jaws showing.

lines.zh: 沙子在我身下塌成一道沟。
lines.en: The sand caves into a trench beneath me.

lines.zh: 我用六条腿刨着往前走。
lines.en: I dig forward with six legs.
This stretch is my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边摆头，找震动。
lines.en: I sway my head as I go, reading vibrations.
I work my way down the sand slope.
I work around the back of the dune.

lines.zh: 走一步，沙就往下滑一点。
lines.en: Each step slides a little sand down.
My body runs cooler than the sand.
I push my antennae forward.
There is a pit ahead. I go around.
I shake the sand off my back.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚印走了一段。
lines.en: I follow your tracks for a stretch.
I dislike walking on stone.
I flatten myself against the ground.
That sand is loose. Easy digging.
My claw marks trail behind me.
I shift into the shade.
I lie still and wait for a tremor.
Under the sand is my home.
If I do not move, prey will come.
My jaws open and close, testing.
The sun is out and I cannot be bothered.
My antennae quiver in the wind.
Something is crawling underground.
I sink myself a little deeper.
I have guarded this nest a long while.
Footsteps, still far off.
I mound the sand into a small slope.
I hear wings.

lines.zh: 你个子大，可你踩在沙上。
lines.en: You are big, but you stand on sand.
I look up. Only a little.
You're blocking the mouth of my pit.
I know this kind of tremor.
There's sand stuck to your soles.
I am not often seen.
Will you stay and watch?
These jaws are not decoration.
It is busier under the sand than you think.
One turn and I am buried again.
I flinch. That hurts.
Who stepped on my back?
There is a mark on my shell.
I retreat into the sand.
My mandibles got knocked askew.
I clamp my jaws shut.
Blood drips onto the sand.
My legs tremble; I cannot stand steady.
I dig deeper.
It hurts, and I can still bite.
I am not impressed by that.
You'd have to bury it in the sand first.
Try setting it on the sand.
I poke my head out and sniff.
If it is edible, I will take it.
Do not reach in. I bite.
Not worth crawling out for.
I take it and drag it under.
Food is scarce around here.
Do you have more on you?

lines.zh: 你踩在沙坑边上，滑下来了。
lines.en: You stepped on the pit edge and slid.
One shove and you give half a step.
My shell is harder than you would guess.

lines.zh: 沙子把我的力气卸掉了。
lines.en: The sand soaks up most of the blow.
Do not step there. It is hollow below.
I slip past under your feet.
You struck a dune.
I kick sand up.
Bumping into me does you no good.
Back up. I need to dig in.
We meet under the sand; no one sees.
I tap the sand wall with my jaws.
This pit is room enough for us.
We take turns guarding the mouth.
It is a size smaller than I.
The sand slumps and we each pull back.
Down here it is very quiet.
We push the sand into a ramp.
It digs first; I follow.

lines.zh: 散场的时候，沙子落了满身。
lines.en: When we part, sand falls all over us.
Something fell into my pit.
I pinch it in my jaws.
Is this edible?
My mandibles slipped right off it.
I push it to the edge of the pit.
I keep this and study it.
I climb up with it in my jaws.
Someone's? I am not returning it.
It is wedged between my legs.
I bury it.
The tremor came from over there.
I turn my head toward you.
I know that sound. It is alive.
You took three steps closer.
The sand tells me everything.
I open my jaws.
This time I strike first.
I hold it between my jaws and wait.
You stepped on the rim of my pit.
That counts as you delivering yourself.
I bury my rear in the sand.
I am lined up.
I follow you under the sand.
I hear the sand shifting under you.
I circle beneath your feet.
You cannot tell which side I am on.
When the sand shifts, you see it.
No hurry. The pit is mine.
The more you struggle, the deeper you sink.
My jaws wait beside you.
I know every inch of this sand.
One more step back and you are at the bottom.
A sand pellet flies out to test you.

lines.zh: 沙正一点点吃掉你的脚。
lines.en: The sand is swallowing your feet, bit by bit.
I bite into your ankle.
A sand pellet strikes your knee.
I push up against your leg.
These jaws are pincers.
I tear upward from below.
You pull your leg free and the sand caves.
I am already back under.

lines.zh: 再出来的时候，换个角度。
lines.en: When I surface again, it is from another angle.
That much blood will do for today.
Your foot went through.
A crack opens in the sand.
I roll up from below.
This sand suits me.
First I dig a pit.
The wind has smoothed the sand.
I shake the grains from my back.
This is a new place.
I smell rain.

lines.zh: 我绕着这片地走了一圈。
lines.en: I pace a circle around this ground.
The ground is loose enough to dig.
I bury half my body.
No one can see me.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的壳，一下就裂了。
lines.en: Fire cracks my shell.

lines.zh: 从沙坑上摔下来，腿都岔了。
lines.en: I fall from the pit edge and my legs splay.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的坑，我拼命往上爬。
lines.en: Water floods my pit and I claw upward.

lines.zh: 炸起来的沙把我埋了半截。
lines.en: The blast buries me half over in sand.
Something lodges between my segments.

lines.zh: 这股怪力让我的颚发麻。
lines.en: The strange force numbs my jaws.
Starving, I bite the sand itself.

lines.zh: 雷劈在沙上，我整个缩成一团。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sand and I curl tight.
The ground is gone, and the sand with it.
